# ECO Archive

> Unofficial wiki for Emil Chronicle Online (ECO).

Every page is available as HTML (`page.html`) and as a clean Markdown copy (`page.md`). Big list pages (equipment, monsters, maps...) point to JSON files in `data/` instead of repeating every entry. Ids look like `item:60050000`, `monster:10000000`, `map:10023000`, `npc:11000044`, `skill:2483`, `job:bard`; pages use the same ids as anchors (for example `equipment.html#item:60050000`).

## Data

- [Data file guide](data/README.md): fields of every file
- [data/ability-vectors.json](data/ability-vectors.json): Iris card ability vectors (215 entries)
- [data/boxes.json](data/boxes.json): Boxes and their contents (40 entries)
- [data/crafting-recipes.json](data/crafting-recipes.json): Craftable items and their recipes from Craftable Items (1448 entries)
- [data/demic-chips.json](data/demic-chips.json): DEMIC chips (940 entries)
- [data/dual-jobs.json](data/dual-jobs.json): Dual job systems (12 entries)
- [data/equipment.json](data/equipment.json): Weapons and armor from the Weapons & Armor page (1852 entries)
- [data/fishing.json](data/fishing.json): Fishing catches (192 entries)
- [data/iris-cards.json](data/iris-cards.json): Iris cards (1039 entries)
- [data/items.json](data/items.json): Every item in the game data (28722 entries)
- [data/jobs.json](data/jobs.json): Every job (52 entries)
- [data/maps.json](data/maps.json): Every map (190 entries)
- [data/marionettes.json](data/marionettes.json): Marionettes and golems (56 entries)
- [data/materials.json](data/materials.json): Crafting materials from Crafting Materials (1026 entries)
- [data/monsters.json](data/monsters.json): Every monster (1316 entries)
- [data/npcs.json](data/npcs.json): Every NPC in the client data (5797 entries)
- [data/partners.json](data/partners.json): Partners (674 entries)
- [data/quests.json](data/quests.json): Quest counter quests from the client data (1377 entries)
- [data/shops.json](data/shops.json): Shops and merchants (143 entries)
- [data/skills.json](data/skills.json): Every job skill (862 entries)
- [data/stamps.json](data/stamps.json): Stamps (218 entries)
